name: Node Load X Parameter (COMPAS CEM)
description: Set the X component of a node load as an optimization parameter.

inputParameters.name: node_key
inputParameters.description: The key of a COMPAS CEM node that carries a load.

inputParameters.name: bound_low
inputParameters.description: The smallest X component the node load may take. The start value must lie between the bounds. Defaults to '-inf'.

inputParameters.name: bound_up
inputParameters.description: The largest X component the node load may take. The start value must lie between the bounds. Defaults to '+inf'.

outputParameters.name: parameter
outputParameters.description: A COMPAS CEM node load X parameter.
